members.speakLineEn: Dedicate a section to negative controls.

members.speakLineEn: Reviewers prefer precise claims over sweeping ones.
members.speakLineZh: 審稿人寧可要精確主張。

members.senseAnchor: have a conference in order to talk something over; present
members.speakLineEn: The panel will confer before announcing rankings.
members.speakLineZh: 小組將在宣布排名前商議。

members.speakLineEn: From silence we should not infer consent.
members.speakLineZh: 不該從沉默推論出同意。

members.speakLineEn: Please refer to the appendix for full tables.
members.speakLineZh: 完整表格請參考附錄。

members.speakLineEn: The paper offers a narrower mechanism than advertised.
members.speakLineZh: 論文提供的機制比宣傳更窄。

members.senseAnchor: a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection; present for acceptance or rejection
members.speakLineEn: Counsel proffered an alternative reading of the clause.
members.speakLineZh: 律師正式提出另一種解讀。

members.speakLineEn: A fertile debate generated testable hypotheses.
members.speakLineZh: 多產辯論產生可檢驗假說。

members.speakLineEn: Metrics proliferate when incentives reward counting.
members.speakLineZh: 誘因獎勵計數時指標激增。

members.speakLineEn: Experts differ on how to weight outliers.
members.speakLineZh: 專家對極端值加權有分歧。

members.speakLineEn: An indifferent public still shapes turnout math.
members.speakLineZh: 冷漠公眾仍形塑投票率。

members.speakLineEn: The design will suffer if power is too low.
members.speakLineZh: 檢定力太低，設計會受苦。

members.speakLineEn: A referendum cannot replace careful cost analysis.
members.speakLineZh: 公投不能取代成本分析。

members.speakLineEn: Stay within the circumference of the defined construct.
members.speakLineZh: 停留在構念圓周內。

members.speakLineEn: Final analyses should match the preregistered set.
members.speakLineZh: 最終分析應對齊預註冊集合。

members.speakLineEn: Finish robustness before press quotes.
members.speakLineZh: 新聞稿前先完成穩健檢查。

members.speakLineEn: Attention is finite; prioritize claims.
members.speakLineZh: 注意力有限；排序主張。

members.speakLineEn: Infinite flexibility makes false positives infinite too.
members.speakLineZh: 無限彈性也讓假陽性無限。

members.speakLineEn: Define success criteria before launch.
members.speakLineZh: 啟動前定義成功標準。

members.speakLineEn: Refine the codebook after pilot disagreements.
members.speakLineZh: 試點分歧後精煉編碼簿。

members.speakLineEn: Confine exploratory plots to a sandbox.
members.speakLineZh: 探索圖關在沙盒內。

members.senseAnchor: a habitual attraction to some activity or thing
members.speakLineEn: Affinity for a theory can bias coding.
members.speakLineZh: 對理論的親近感會偏差編碼。

members.speakLineEn: Who finances the trial must be disclosed.
members.speakLineZh: 誰資助試驗必須揭露。

members.senseAnchor: the closing part, scene, or number
members.speakLineEn: The finale should restate limits, not hype.
members.speakLineZh: 終章應重申限制，而非炒作。

members.speakLineEn: No single study is definitive.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有單一研究具決定性。

members.speakLineEn: Indefinite postponement kills accountability.
members.speakLineZh: 無限期延期殺死課責。

members.speakLineEn: Treat editorial finality as provisional.
members.speakLineZh: 把編輯定局當暫定。

members.speakLineEn: Each refinement should be logged.
members.speakLineZh: 每次精煉應記錄。

members.speakLineEn: Unfinished robustness is unfinished science.
members.speakLineZh: 未完成穩健＝未完成科學。

clusters.script: 社會要 progress 向前走；失敗就 regress 退步。aggressive 人步步進逼，digress 演講走歪路。congress 走到一起開會；egress 是出口那一步。grade 是階梯等級，gradual 一步一步。

members.speakLineEn: Progress requires measurable milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 進步需要可測量的里程碑。

members.senseAnchor: the reasoning involved when you assume the conclusion is true and reason backward to the evidence; returning to a former state
members.speakLineEn: Under stress, teams may regress to safer routines.
members.speakLineZh: 壓力下團隊可能退回更安全的例行做法。

members.speakLineEn: Aggressive coding can introduce new bugs.
members.speakLineZh: 過度積極的編碼可能引入新錯誤。

members.senseAnchor: lose clarity or turn aside especially from the main subject of attention or course of argument in writing, thinking, or speaking; wander from a direct or straight course
members.speakLineEn: Let me digress briefly, then return to the claim.
members.speakLineZh: 容我短暫離題，再回到主張。

members.speakLineEn: The congress of specialists produced a joint statement.
members.speakLineZh: 專家大會產出了聯合聲明。

members.speakLineEn: Clear egress routes are part of lab safety.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚的出口動線是實驗室安全的一部分。

members.speakLineEn: We grade evidence by design quality, not by hype.
members.speakLineZh: 我們依設計品質評分證據，而非依炒作。

members.speakLineEn: Change was gradual rather than revolutionary.
members.speakLineZh: 改變是逐漸的，而非革命性的。

members.speakLineEn: Noise can degrade signal quality.
members.speakLineZh: 噪音會降低訊號品質。

members.speakLineEn: The policy looks retrograde by current standards.
members.speakLineZh: 以現行標準看，該政策顯得倒退。

members.senseAnchor: to fail to keep the rule
members.speakLineEn: To transgress the protocol voids the trial.
members.speakLineZh: 逾越協議會使試驗無效。

members.speakLineEn: Inject one clarifying example into the paragraph.

members.speakLineEn: Do not project motives without evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 沒有證據就不要投射動機。

members.speakLineEn: The conclusion is still conjecture, not proof.
members.speakLineZh: 結論仍是臆測，不是證明。

members.speakLineEn: Security ejected disruptors from the hall.
members.speakLineZh: 保全把搗亂者驅離會場。

members.speakLineEn: Subjects were randomly assigned to conditions.

members.speakLineEn: Counsel objected to the leading question.

members.speakLineEn: Career trajectory is not destiny.
members.speakLineZh: 職涯軌跡不是命運。

members.speakLineEn: Please do not interject until the claim is finished.
members.speakLineZh: 請等論點說完再插話。

members.speakLineEn: A metaphor can become a rhetorical projectile.

members.speakLineEn: Judge models by out-of-sample performance.
members.speakLineZh: 用樣本外表現判斷模型。

members.senseAnchor: decreed by or proceeding from a court of justice; belonging or appropriate to the office of a judge
members.speakLineEn: Keep a judicial separation between exploration and confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 探索與確認保持司法式分離。

members.speakLineEn: Judicious pruning of covariates beats kitchen-sink models.
members.speakLineZh: 審慎修剪共變勝過一鍋炒。

members.speakLineEn: Prejudice enters when labels leak into coding.
members.speakLineZh: 標籤洩漏進編碼時偏見進入。

members.senseAnchor: to hear and settle a case, dispute or conflict
members.speakLineEn: Let a precommitted rule adjudicate borderline cases.
members.speakLineZh: 用預先承諾規則裁決邊界案例。

members.speakLineEn: A jury of peers still needs conflict disclosures.
members.speakLineZh: 同儕陪審仍需利益揭露。

members.speakLineEn: Procedural justice matters in authorship disputes.
members.speakLineZh: 作者權爭議中程序正義重要。

members.speakLineEn: Justify each exclusion in one sentence.
members.speakLineZh: 每項排除用一句話證明正當。

members.speakLineEn: Citation injustice tracks prestige gradients.
members.speakLineZh: 引用不義追蹤聲望梯度。

members.senseAnchor: criminal offense of making false statements under oath
members.speakLineEn: Fabrication is the perjury of science.
members.speakLineZh: 造假是科學的偽證。

members.speakLineEn: Underpowered studies can still cause injury via false hope.
members.speakLineZh: 低檢定力研究仍可透過假希望造成傷害。

members.speakLineEn: Juridical metaphors help, but biology is not a courtroom.
members.speakLineZh: 法律隱喻有用，但生物不是法庭。

members.speakLineEn: Suspend judgment until diagnostics are clean.
members.speakLineZh: 診斷乾淨前先懸置判斷。

members.speakLineEn: Prejudicial language in reviews should be edited out.
members.speakLineZh: 審稿中的偏見語言應刪除。

members.speakLineEn: Unjust authorship norms waste talent.
members.speakLineZh: 不公正作者規範浪費人才。

members.senseAnchor: speech you make to yourself; a (usually long) dramatic speech intended to give the illusion of unspoken reflections
members.speakLineEn: The chapter reads like a soliloquy, not a dialogue with critics.
members.speakLineZh: 這章讀起來像獨白，而非與批評者對話。

members.speakLineEn: Grandiloquent promises outran the budget.
members.speakLineZh: 誇大承諾超越了預算。

members.speakLineEn: Check the logic before polishing the prose.
members.speakLineZh: 先檢查邏輯，再打磨文筆。

members.speakLineEn: A strained analogy misleads more than it teaches.
members.speakLineZh: 牽強類比誤導多於教學。

members.senseAnchor: a formal expression of praise for someone who has died recently; a formal expression of praise
members.speakLineEn: The eulogy praised method as much as results.
members.speakLineZh: 頌詞對方法與結果同樣稱許。

members.speakLineEn: The prologue frames why the question matters.
members.speakLineZh: 序言框定了問題為何重要。

members.speakLineEn: Loquacity is not the same as clarity.
members.speakLineZh: 話多不等於清楚。

members.senseAnchor: an expert manner of speaking involving control of voice and gesture
members.speakLineEn: Elocution cannot rescue a hollow argument.
members.speakLineZh: 演說技巧救不了空洞論證。

members.speakLineEn: Ideology can script which analogies feel natural.
members.speakLineZh: 意識形態會編排哪些類比顯得自然。

members.speakLineZh: 謠言比澄清傳得更快。

members.speakLineEn: Do not dismiss anomalous data too quickly.
members.speakLineZh: 不要太快把異常資料打發掉。

members.speakLineEn: It would be remiss to ignore conflicting studies.
members.speakLineZh: 忽略互相衝突的研究會是疏忽。

members.senseAnchor: someone sent on a mission to represent the interests of someone else
members.speakLineEn: An emissary carried the compromise proposal.
members.speakLineZh: 一名密使帶著妥協方案。

members.speakLineEn: The design does not permit causal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 該設計不允許做出因果宣稱。

members.speakLineEn: Authors must submit raw data upon request.

members.senseAnchor: coming and going at intervals, not continuous
members.speakLineEn: Intermittent funding stalled the longitudinal design.
members.speakLineZh: 斷續經費讓縱貫設計停擺。

members.speakLineEn: The mission of the review is synthesis, not discovery.
members.speakLineZh: 該評論的使命是綜整，不是發現。

members.senseAnchor: a written message addressed to a person or organization
members.speakLineEn: A terse missive ended the collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 一封簡短書信結束了合作。

members.speakLineEn: Only admissible evidence should shape the verdict.
members.speakLineZh: 只有可採納證據才應影響裁決。

members.speakLineEn: The omission of a control group weakens inference.
members.speakLineZh: 遺漏對照組削弱了推論。

members.senseAnchor: understanding and entering into another's feelings

members.speakLineEn: Sympathy alone cannot allocate scarce beds.

members.speakLineEn: The speech relied more on pathos than on proof.

members.senseAnchor: a feeling of intense dislike; the object of a feeling of intense aversion; something to be avoided

members.speakLineEn: The model treats misinformation like a pathogen.

members.senseAnchor: the branch of medical science that studies the causes and nature and effects of diseases; any deviation from a healthy or normal condition

members.speakLineEn: Good editors are not telepathic; mark your claims.
members.speakLineZh: 好編輯不是心靈感應——請標明你的主張。

clusters.script: compel 強迫推動；expel 推出去；repel 推開。impulse 衝動推力，propel 向前推，dispel 驅散。pulse 脈搏，compel／compulsory 強制，expulsion 開除，repellent 令人反感，impel 驅使，pulsate 搏動。

members.speakLineEn: Evidence should compel revision, not loyalty tests.
members.speakLineZh: 證據應強迫修正，而非忠誠測驗。

members.speakLineEn: Schools rarely expel for honest error, but silence does.
members.speakLineZh: 學校少因誠實錯誤開除，沉默卻會。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move back by force or influence; be repellent to; cause aversion in
members.speakLineEn: Opaque methods repel collaborators.
members.speakLineZh: 不透明方法讓合作者反感。

members.speakLineEn: Resist the impulse to peek at outcomes early.
members.speakLineZh: 忍住提早偷看結果的衝動。

members.senseAnchor: cause to move forward with force; give an incentive for action
members.speakLineEn: Clear stakes propel careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 清楚利害推進細讀。

members.speakLineEn: Open data can dispel rumors of selective reporting.
members.speakLineZh: 開放資料能驅散選擇性報告謠言。

members.speakLineEn: Take the pulse of the literature with living reviews.
members.speakLineZh: 用持續評論為文獻把脈。

members.speakLineEn: Compulsory preregistration changes gaming incentives.
members.speakLineZh: 強制預註冊改變投機誘因。

members.senseAnchor: the act of forcing out someone or something; squeezing out by applying pressure
members.speakLineEn: Expulsion from a consortium should follow due process.
members.speakLineZh: 逐出聯盟應有正當程序。

members.speakLineEn: A repellent tone loses persuadable readers.
members.speakLineZh: 反感語氣失去可說服讀者。

members.senseAnchor: urge or force (a person) to an action; constrain or motivate; cause to move forward with force
members.speakLineEn: Curiosity should impel checks, not shortcuts.
members.speakLineZh: 好奇應驅使核查，而非捷徑。

members.speakLineEn: Attention pulsates with media cycles.
members.speakLineZh: 注意力隨媒體週期搏動。

members.senseAnchor: a propelling force; the act of propelling
members.speakLineEn: Citation propulsion is not the same as truth-tracking.
members.speakLineZh: 引用推進力≠追蹤真理。

members.senseAnchor: the force by which bodies repel one another; intense aversion
members.speakLineEn: Mutual repulsion between camps blocks synthesis.
members.speakLineZh: 陣營互斥阻礙綜整。

members.senseAnchor: an urge to do or say something that might be better left undone or unsaid; an irrational motive for performing trivial or repetitive actions, even against your will
members.speakLineEn: Under compulsion, consent is compromised.
members.speakLineZh: 強迫下同意已打折。

members.speakLineEn: Results are pending ethics clearance.
members.speakLineZh: 結果尚待倫理審查。

members.speakLineEn: Suspend recruitment when adverse events cluster.
members.speakLineZh: 不良事件群聚時暫停收案。

members.speakLineEn: Estimates depend on the exclusion restriction.
members.speakLineZh: 估計依賴排除限制。

members.speakLineEn: Independent replication beats in-house confirmation.
members.speakLineZh: 獨立複現勝過內部確認。

members.speakLineEn: Append the codebook to the replication package.
members.speakLineZh: 把編碼簿附加到複現包。

members.speakLineEn: Put long tables in an appendix.
members.speakLineZh: 長表放附錄。

members.speakLineEn: Weighting can compensate for known nonresponse.
members.speakLineZh: 加權可補償已知不回應。

members.senseAnchor: administer or bestow, as in small portions; grant a dispensation; grant an exemption
members.speakLineEn: We can dispense with decorative citations.
members.speakLineZh: 我們可以免除裝飾性引用。

members.senseAnchor: thinking deeply about something that worries you
members.speakLineEn: A pensive tone is fine; vagueness is not.
members.speakLineZh: 沉思語氣可以；含糊不行。

members.senseAnchor: money paid out; an amount spent; the act of spending money for goods or services
members.speakLineEn: Track expenditure against preregistered milestones.
members.speakLineZh: 依預註冊里程碑追蹤支出。

members.speakLineEn: Pension systems illustrate long-horizon policy tradeoffs.
members.speakLineZh: 退休金制度說明長期政策取捨。

members.senseAnchor: a straight line at right angles to another line; a Gothic style in 14th and 15th century England; characterized by vertical lines and a four-centered (Tudor) arch and fan vaulting
members.speakLineEn: Keep axes perpendicular and honestly scaled.
members.speakLineZh: 軸線保持垂直且誠實刻度。

members.senseAnchor: be imminent or about to happen; close in time; about to occur
members.speakLineEn: Impending deadlines distort careful reading.
members.speakLineZh: 迫近截止扭曲細讀。

members.speakLineEn: A pendant caveat cannot rescue a broken design.
members.speakLineZh: 垂吊的但書救不了壞設計。

members.speakLineEn: Estimate propensity with covariates chosen ex ante.
members.speakLineZh: 用事先選好的共變估計傾向。

members.speakLineEn: The import of the finding is practical, not merely theoretical.
members.speakLineZh: 該發現的重要性是實務的。

members.speakLineEn: Methods that export poorly across cultures need local tests.
members.speakLineZh: 難跨文化輸出的方法需在地檢驗。

members.speakLineEn: The metaphor of deporting outliers can hide selection bias.
members.speakLineZh: 『驅逐極端值』可能掩蓋選擇偏差。

members.speakLineEn: A portable checklist travels between labs.
members.speakLineZh: 可移植檢核表能在實驗室間旅行。

members.senseAnchor: a state of overwhelming usually pleasurable emotion
members.speakLineEn: How we transport samples affects degradation.
members.speakLineZh: 樣本運輸方式影響降解。

members.speakLineEn: Important claims deserve pre-registered tests.
members.speakLineZh: 重要主張值得預註冊檢驗。

members.senseAnchor: suitable or at a time that is suitable or advantageous especially for a particular purpose
members.speakLineEn: An opportune pause let cooler evidence speak.
members.speakLineZh: 合時停頓讓冷靜證據說話。

members.speakLineEn: Missing data is also a missed opportunity for honesty.
members.speakLineZh: 缺漏資料也是錯失誠實機會。

members.speakLineEn: Correlations alone rarely support causal claims.
members.speakLineZh: 單靠相關很少支撐因果。

members.speakLineEn: Report effect sizes with intervals, not stars alone.
members.speakLineZh: 報告效應量請帶區間。

members.speakLineEn: A methods portfolio beats a single fashionable tool.
members.speakLineZh: 方法組合勝過單一流行工具。

members.senseAnchor: the intended meaning of a communication; the pervading meaning or tenor
members.speakLineEn: The statute purports to protect privacy broadly.
members.speakLineZh: 法條聲稱要廣泛保護隱私。

members.speakLineEn: That leap from survey to policy is insupportable.
members.speakLineZh: 從問卷跳到政策無法支撐。

members.speakLineEn: Think of operationalization as the porter of concepts.
members.speakLineZh: 操作型定義像概念搬運工。

members.zhGloss: 運動；炫耀（古義 disport 近）
members.senseAnchor: an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition; the occupation of athletes who compete for pay
members.speakLineEn: Do not sport with definitions mid-argument.
members.speakLineZh: 論證中途不要拿定義嬉戲。

members.speakLineEn: We propose a preregistered analysis plan.
members.speakLineZh: 我們提議預註冊分析計畫。

members.speakLineEn: Do not impose a narrative the data cannot carry.
members.speakLineZh: 不要強加資料扛不起的敘事。

members.speakLineEn: Compose the abstract after results are stable.
members.speakLineZh: 結果穩定後再寫摘要。

members.speakLineEn: How labs dispose of failed trials shapes the literature.
members.speakLineZh: 失敗試驗怎麼處置形塑文獻。

members.speakLineEn: Replication can expose fragile findings.
members.speakLineZh: 複現能揭露脆弱發現。

members.speakLineEn: Stakeholders may oppose transparency that threatens rents.
members.speakLineZh: 利害關係人可能反對威脅租金的透明。

members.speakLineEn: Postpone celebration until robustness checks pass.
members.speakLineZh: 穩健檢查通過前先延期慶祝。

members.speakLineEn: Trust is a component of cumulative science.
members.speakLineZh: 信任是累積科學的元件。

members.speakLineEn: A positive result still needs a credible mechanism.
members.speakLineZh: 陽性結果仍需可信機制。

members.speakLineEn: Deposit raw files in a trusted repository.
members.speakLineZh: 原始檔存進可信儲庫。

members.speakLineEn: Juxtapose the two models to show the gap.
members.speakLineZh: 並置兩模型以顯示差距。

members.speakLineEn: A public repository reduces private hoarding of data.
members.speakLineZh: 公開儲庫減少私藏。

members.senseAnchor: (logic) a statement that affirms or denies something and is either true or false; a proposal offered for acceptance or rejection
members.speakLineEn: State the proposition before you defend it.
members.speakLineZh: 先陳述命題再辯護。

members.speakLineEn: Do not superimpose ideology on measurement choices.
members.speakLineZh: 不要把意識形態疊加在測量上。

members.speakLineEn: An early exponent of open methods faced resistance.
members.speakLineZh: 開放方法早期倡導者遇阻力。

members.speakLineZh: 洩漏後爭議爆發。

members.speakLineEn: The theory is morally bankrupt if it excuses harm.
members.speakLineZh: 若為傷害開脫，該理論在道德上已破產。

members.senseAnchor: state of being torn or burst open; a personal or social separation (as between opposing factions)

members.speakLineEn: An irruption of cases overwhelmed the clinic model.

members.speakLineEn: The eruption of outrage was predictable.
members.speakLineZh: 憤怒的爆發其實可預期。

members.speakLineEn: Data corruption invalidated the third trial.
members.speakLineZh: 資料損壞使第三次試驗無效。

members.speakLineEn: Disruptive claims need stronger evidence, not louder ads.
members.speakLineZh: 顛覆式宣稱需要更強證據，而非更大聲廣告。

clusters.hook: 一邊跪著誇，一邊用睫毛從天花板瞪你。
clusters.script: 辦公室裡 sycophant／toady 會 fawn 巴結；對面座位坐著 arrogant、supercilious、imperious 的主管，睫毛好像長在額頭上往下掃視。
reviewHooks: supercilious ≈ super + cilium（睫毛）在上往下看
pitfalls: fawn 另有『小鹿』義，考試多為動詞巴結
sycophant 諧音可記，但答題要回到『諂媚者』

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage
members.speakLineEn: A sycophant praises power, not evidence.
members.speakLineZh: 諂媚者歌頌的是權力，不是證據。

members.senseAnchor: a person who tries to please someone in order to gain a personal advantage; try to gain favor by cringing or flattering
members.speakLineEn: He dismissed the aide as a political toady.
members.speakLineZh: 他把那名助理斥為政治馬屁精。

members.speakLineEn: Junior analysts should not fawn over every fashion in theory.
members.speakLineZh: 初級分析師不該對每個理論時尚巴結奉承。

members.speakLineEn: An arrogant tone can sink an otherwise sound argument.
members.speakLineZh: 傲慢語氣可能毁掉本來站得住的論證。

members.speakLineEn: Her supercilious smile dismissed the objection.
members.speakLineZh: 她目空一切的笑把異議掃掉。

members.senseAnchor: having or showing arrogant superiority to and disdain of those one views as unworthy; ; ; ; ; ; ; - W.L.Shirer
members.speakLineEn: An imperious email rarely invites collaboration.
members.speakLineZh: 專橫的郵件很少帶來合作。

clusters.hook: 一邊痛到倒吸涼氣說不出話，一邊嘎嚕嚕叫不停。
clusters.script: 會議室左排 taciturn、reticent、laconic——能不說就不說；右排 loquacious、garrulous、verbose——停不下來。
pitfalls: reticent 強調『不願透露』；taciturn 強調『生性少話』
loquacious 中性偏多話；garrulous 更嫌喋喋

members.speakLineEn: The taciturn witness answered in monosyllables.
members.speakLineZh: 沉默的證人只用單音節回答。

members.senseAnchor: inclined to be silent or uncommunicative in speech
members.speakLineEn: She remained reticent about her funding sources.
members.speakLineZh: 她對資金來源仍不輕易透露。

members.speakLineEn: His laconic reply ended the discussion.
members.speakLineZh: 他言簡意賅的回覆結束了討論。

members.speakLineEn: A loquacious narrator can bury the plot.
members.speakLineZh: 滔滔不絕的敘事者可能把情節埋掉。

members.speakLineEn: The garrulous memoir digresses endlessly.
members.speakLineZh: 這本喋喋不休的回憶錄沒完没了地離題。

members.senseAnchor: using or containing too many words
members.speakLineEn: Cut verbose transitions; keep the claim sharp.
members.speakLineZh: 刪掉冗長過渡，讓論點保持鋒利。

clusters.hook: 熱可樂一開就炸，對面卻始終春風笑。

members.speakLineEn: The irascible professor dismissed soft questions.
members.speakLineZh: 暴躁教授直接打發軟問題。

members.speakLineEn: Peevish objections rarely improve the draft.
members.speakLineZh: 壞脾氣的反對很少能改好草稿。

members.speakLineEn: An affable chair kept the panel constructive.
members.speakLineZh: 和藹的主席讓座談保持建設性。

members.senseAnchor: diffusing warmth and friendliness; of or relating to the chin or median part of the lower jaw
members.speakLineEn: His genial tone disarmed hostile reviewers.
members.speakLineZh: 他溫和的語氣化解了敵意審稿人。

members.speakLineEn: Amiable colleagues still need clear standards.
members.speakLineZh: 親切同事依然需要清楚標準。
